marketSummary: Indian benchmark indices closed at fresh nine-month highs on Friday, November 20, 2026, with the Nifty 50 vaulting 1.12% to settle at 25,800.60 and the Sensex rallying 898 points to 83,919.71. Heavy institutional liquidity drove the move as foreign portfolio investors poured a monthly record of over $12.2 billion into domestic equities, executing an aggressive rotation away from Asian tech selloffs into Indian financials. Bank Nifty broke out to record territory above 64,635, while defensive sectors including healthcare also surged. Meanwhile, BSE Index Services triggered substantial swing catalysts with its periodic reconstitution announcement affecting Trent, Shriram Finance, and BSE 100 members.
dailyFocus: Monitor continuation moves in large-cap banking and healthcare breakouts, manage positioning around BSE Sensex and BSE 100 rebalancing adjustments slated for December 21, and track supply-chain execution updates across core defence counters.

news.headline: BSE Index Services Excludes Trent from Benchmark Sensex Effective December 21
news.summary: BSE Index Services announced its semi-annual reconstitution on November 20, 2026, dropping Trent Limited from the 30-share BSE Sensex and reallocating it to the BSE Sensex Next 30 index effective December 21, 2026.
news.impact: Exclusion creates multi-week passive outflow supply that could stall overhead breakout attempts near base resistance.

news.headline: Shriram Finance Selected to Enter 30-Stock BSE Sensex in Semi-Annual Reconstitution
news.summary: Shriram Finance will officially join the benchmark BSE Sensex at the open of trading on December 21, 2026, replacing retail major Trent Limited in the premier 30-stock gauge.
news.impact: Mandatory tracker buying provides strong upward liquidity and reduces downside risk on pullbacks toward breakout pivots.

news.headline: BHEL and GE Vernova T&D Added to BSE 100 Index in Reconstitution
news.summary: BSE Index Services confirmed on November 20, 2026, that Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited and GE Vernova T&D India will enter the BSE 100 and BSE Sensex Next 50 indices effective December 21, replacing names including PNB and Havells.
news.impact: Institutional benchmark inclusion increases institutional trading volume and supports stage-base accumulation.

news.headline: BEL Hosts BRIDGE 2026 Conclave to Accelerate Global Export Footprint
news.summary: Bharat Electronics convened international defence attachés and government officials at the BRIDGE 2026 conclave in New Delhi on November 19-20, releasing an export product catalogue following recently secured domestic orders worth 619 crore rupees.
news.impact: Expansion into export pipelines strengthens the order backlog, bolstering multi-week consolidation support.

news.headline: Bank Nifty Surges 2.49% to Record 64,635 Driven by Heavyweights
news.summary: The Bank Nifty index surged 1,572 points to close at an all-time peak of 64,635.20 on November 20, 2026, as Kotak Mahindra Bank and HDFC Bank rallied over 3% amid concentrated institutional accumulation.
news.impact: A clean structural breakout into uncharted territory anchors risk-on momentum across large-cap financial swing trades.

news.headline: Nifty 50 Clinches 4th Winning Week Above 25,800 on Record $12B FII Inflows
news.summary: The Nifty 50 advanced 1.12% to close at 25,800.60 on November 20, 2026, as foreign investors channeled over 1.11 lakh crore rupees into Indian shares during November, pivoting sharply away from regional tech weakness.
news.impact: Aggressive foreign institutional net buying provides broad market support for swing trade breakout setups.

news.headline: GE Aerospace Ships 15th F404-IN20 Engine, Easing Tejas Mk1A Delivery Logjams
news.summary: GE Aerospace has dispatched its 15th F404 powerplant to Hindustan Aeronautics on November 20, 2026, providing critical execution momentum toward the Indian Air Force's target of forming the first operational Tejas Mk1A squadron by March 2027.
news.impact: Resolving engine delivery bottlenecks relieves delivery overhang and supports base breakout continuation.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard and Damen Shipyards Group Formalize Green Vessel Partnership
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard signed an MoU with the Netherlands-based Damen Shipyards Group at the India Shipbuilding Investment Conclave to construct low-emission, hybrid and specialised tugs, following the ASTDS 70T tug keel-laying on November 18.
news.impact: Partnership reinforces high-tech maritime positioning and provides momentum to overcome prior swing supply bands.

news.headline: Divis Laboratories Replaces Wipro in BSE Sensex 50 Index
news.summary: In the index review announced on November 20, 2026, BSE Index Services selected Divis Laboratories to replace IT major Wipro in the BSE Sensex 50 effective December 21, 2026.
news.impact: Index-tracker rebalancing will generate steady passive accumulation, supporting price stability above moving-average clusters.

news.headline: CG Power Intimates Senior Executive Exit Ahead of Citigroup-Organized Analyst Meet
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions notified exchanges that VP Services Rajat Shah resigned effective November 17, 2026, while the company prepares to host an analyst meet organized by Citigroup on November 27.
news.impact: The upcoming November 27 analyst conference acts as the next pricing trigger while the stock consolidates near recent lows.
